# G97 fixture provenance

The `cisco/` files contain the rendered contents of the Cisco CLI output blocks, starting after the echoed command. The published whitespace, line endings within the blocks, and data are retained, except that the example addresses and MACs were replaced consistently by documentation values (IPv4 RFC 5737, IPv6 2001:db8::/32, MAC 00:00:5e:00:53:NN) in the files and in `test_g97_nxos_overlay.py`; after a replaced table value the padding was adjusted so that the following columns keep their position where the spacing allows it.

| Files | Cisco source |
|---|---|
| `nve_peers.out`, `nve_vni.out`, `evpn_mac_ip_compact.out`, `evpn_mac_ip.out` | Nexus 9000 NX-OS 10.3(x), [Configure VXLAN BGP EVPN](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/td/docs/dcn/nx-os/nexus9000/103x/configuration/vxlan/cisco-nexus-9000-series-nx-os-vxlan-configuration-guide-release-103x/m-configuring-vxlan-bbgp-evpn.html), verification examples. Both MAC/IP outputs echo `show l2route evpn mac-ip all`. |
| `nve_interface_detail.out`, `nve_peers_ipv6.out` | Nexus 9000 NX-OS 9.3(x), [Configure VXLAN with IPv6 in the Underlay](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/td/docs/switches/datacenter/nexus9000/sw/93x/vxlan/configuration/guide/b-cisco-nexus-9000-series-nx-os-vxlan-configuration-guide-93x/b-cisco-nexus-9000-series-nx-os-vxlan-configuration-guide-93x_chapter_010011.html), verification examples. |
| `evpn_bgp_summary.out`, `evpn_bgp_prefix.out` | Nexus 9000 NX-OS 9.3(x), [Configuring Segment Routing](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/td/docs/switches/datacenter/nexus9000/sw/93x/label-switching/b-cisco-nexus-9000-series-nx-os-label-switching-configuration-guide-93x/b-cisco-nexus-9000-series-nx-os-label-switching-configuration-guide-93x_chapter_01000.html). The prefix example ends during its second RD's path. The test for a complete path uses the first RD block as a derived, contiguous excerpt. |

The `lab/` files are anonymized stdout from d-nxos (Nexus 9300v, NX-OS 9.3(12), netops-ro, 2026-11-19 UTC), processed with `tests/support/anonymize_fixture.py --check`. The operational outputs were byte-identical on the two B04 nodes with netops-ro and on d-nxos with netops-admin. Each NVE and BGP EVPN command exited 16 with empty stderr. The MAC/IP table exited 0 with a legend and a header and zero entries. The prefix selector was `192.0.2.0` before anonymization, and the NVE command used `nve1 detail`. The identity capture is `show version` (rc 0).
